definitions.explanation: The branch of mathematics that studies the properties of integers and their relationships.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{整数論|せいすうろん}を{学|まな}ぶ。
{素数|そすう}は{整数論|せいすうろん}の{重要|じゅうよう}なテーマだ。
examples.english: Prime numbers are an important topic in number theory.

examples.japanese: {整数論|せいすうろん}は{数学|すうがく}の{中|なか}でも{特|とく}に{歴史|れきし}の{古|ふる}い{分野|ぶんや}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Number theory is one of the oldest fields within mathematics.

notes:
Composed of {整数|せいすう} (integer) + the suffix {論|ろん} (theory, study of). A core area of pure mathematics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整数論|せいすうろん}を{研究|けんきゅう}する: to research number theory
- {整数論|せいすうろん}の{問題|もんだい}: a number-theory problem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {数論|すうろん}: number theory — a shorter synonym often used interchangeably
- {代数学|だいすうがく}: algebra — a related branch of mathematics
